## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 14, 2026 - Jul 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _13*************_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "Please, can anyone help me get the old app back? I knew the new version was supposed to be terrible & I’ve been careful to NOT update it, however accidents happen & now I’m stuck with the new version. Honestly, if i can’t get the old version back I’m going to delete the app & my account. This is completely unusable 😢"
            2. _Paulidka_26_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "The new user interface completely ruined daily meal tracking. The calorie header disappears when scrolling, "remaining calories" is missing in the diary, and basic tasks now require way too many clicks. The previous layout was so much better, intuitive, and effortlessly easy to use. I have spent years building my custom recipes and meals here, but this update makes the app unusable. Please add a "Classic View" toggle in Settings, just like Light/Dark mode!"
            3. _Dyanomo_, Jun 14, 2026, 1/5: "One must now pay for the barcode scanning which was the main reason I would use this app. It’s now full of bugs and most features are behind a very expensive paywall!"

## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Jul 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _ET That Me_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Used this app for 10 years. Had to get rid of it. Ads everywhere, everything good behind a paywall. Sorry to see it get ruined."
            2. _TheJude69_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "Basic features locked behind premium. Tells you your salt is over daily limit but won’t show you what logged foods are responsible without premium. This is pathetic. You can’t scan barcodes without premium. Money grabbing scum."
            3. _klblank_, Jul 25, 2026, 2/5: "Paid user since 2014 I was along for the ride through all the changes. When they made bar code scanning a paid feature, when they removed the social features which I loved about the app, when the app was constantly crashing I was patient waiting for an update, when they changed the whole look and feel of the app, I took time to see if I could get used to it. Ultimately it’s no longer the right app for me. I have years of data and all my recipes in the database so I’ve been holding on to hope they will listen to the complaints but nothing has improved. I’m finally done. My premium subscription was up for renewal and I cancelled and deleted the app."
